/.title: DAVINCI by Vocdoni
p: DAVINCI is the first voting protocol that meets the criteria for universal adoption
backed by individuals from leading projects
Legacy voting systems are expensive, inaccessible and vulnerable — creating barriers to secure digital participation.

Only governments and large organizations can afford the technology needed to ensure election security, leaving billions without a viable digital citizen participation option and preventing recurrent voting.
This outdated model weakens democracies, highlighting the need for an alternative with a more advanced technological design.

DAVINCI* is a voting protocol designed for mass adoption, privacy, and security. It enables high-frequency, low-cost elections while ensuring transparency, censorship resistance, anticoercion and integrity.
Decentralized Autonomous Vote Integrity Network with Cryptographic Inference
Voting is an essential part of modern life.

DAVINCI is a zk-SNARK–based state machine run by a decentralized network of offchain Sequencers to eliminate the biggest flaws in voting, ensuring privacy, transparency, and security without relying on a central authority.
DAVINCI verifies every vote mathematically, from cast to tally.
It protects voter privacy with a cryptographic design based on Threshold Homomorphic Encryption.
Meets any governance requirement and adapts to any identity system.
Built to scale from dozens to millions of voters.
A shared infrastructure for a cost-efficient voting with minimal setup. Accessible for all.
Ensuring free and fair voting, safeguarding against collusion, vote buying and external pressures.
Ensures data integrity and resistance to censorship, with settlement on Ethereum and other EVM blockchains.

Vocdoni is the team behind DAVINCI. We bring 7 years of experience building decentralized governance for hundreds of political parties, local governments, civic groups, DAOs, and even organizations under repressive regimes.
We believe that a truly fair voting system should be free from political, corporate, or centralized control.
Since 2018, we provided blockchain-based voting  to hundreds of organizations worldwide, including political parties, local governments, associations, sports clubs and DAOs.

Today, new cryptographic tools let us protect privacy and scale to millions of voters at once. So we decided to begin again, designing a voting protocol from scratch that could become the global gold standard for secure, private, and affordable voting.
DAVINCI ensures neutrality by operating on a decentralized infrastructure, where no single entity can manipulate, censor, or bias election results.

It is built as an unstoppable, autonomous voting protocol powered by zero-knowledge cryptography and decentralized infrastructure. By leveraging a token-driven model, DAVINCI becomes a truly autonomous and resilient governance solution.

But Vocdoni doesn’t own this protocol! We’re simply the catalysts. DAVINCI is an open-source and neutral voting system built for the world, and its future depends on collective work. Everyone is welcome to contribute, shape, and improve it.Want to know more? Read the public announcement here.
If you have more questions, check out our FAQ below or feel free to reach out.

A group of Key-Wardens work together to generate a Threshold Homomorphic Encryption Key on Ethereum.Anyone can become a warden for the network.The key ensures that votes remain private. Results can only be decrypted when a majority of wardens collaborate at the end of the voting process. Individual votes are never decrypted.  This guarantees privacy and prevents any single party from accessing the results prematurely.
A group of Sequencers work together to generate a Threshold Encryption Key on Ethereum.
This key ensures that votes remain private and can only be decrypted when a majority of Sequencers collaborate at the end of the voting process.
This guarantees security and prevents any single party from accessing the results prematurely.
Try out secure, anonymous voting firsthand and help us improve the system through real-world feedback.
Read the docs, help us to update it or create your own solutions using it.
Over the years, we're grateful that our work as VOCDONI has gained recognition and support from industry leaders.

Voting, as an important piece of governance, is a fundamental piece for a decentralised world. Being able to organise votings without having to trust in central parties at high scale, is a huge advance for humanity. Vocdoni is taking the last advances in crypto to make it happen.

When digital infrastructure is controlled centrally, websites can be blocked, posts censored, text messages blocked, and votes invalidated, not by brute force alone, but by cutting off the information rails. DAVINCI is building a more secure democratic future: one where ballots live in a distributed network, verification is open and transparent, trust is rooted in math and cryptography, anonymity is preserved, and no actor can suspend civic participation.

I have been full-time in the blockchain industry for ten years. Since day one, trustless but verifiable voting has been one of the main talking points on non-financial applications that blockchains enable. The Vocdoni team is arguably the best equipped team to bring it to the masses.
Voting in DAOs today is a joke, we need real, nation-state-level anonymous voting. We need Vocdoni.

For nearly a decade, Vocdoni has been cooking the future of voting. Recent breakthroughs in ZK and blockchain enabled the ideal solution. DAVINCI stands as the ultimate, unrivaled answer to secure, transformative elections.

Restoring faith in democracy is a vital issue of our time. It can only be achieved if citizens are given the means to effectively participate in collective decision-making. I believe that voting protocols such as Vocdoni’s DAVINCI are an important part of the solution.

Integrating Vocdoni stack into our product was seamless. Its verifiable voting mechanism enhances user trust and transparency. We’re excited to explore DAVINCI’s new protocol upgrade possibilities to enhance even more our voting guarantees.
COO Privado ID and Polygon zkEVM co-founder

DAVINCI has the technical design and attributes to become the universal voting solution for real-world democracy. Together with PrivadoID’s self-sovereign identity solutions, we envision a new generation of secure, tamper-proof and accessible digital democracy.
In today’s digital era, it’s surprising that many voting systems remain outdated, inefficient, and often lack transparency.
DAVINCI is not just a digitalization of elections - it's a transparent, trustless, and censorship-resistant voting solution that overcomes the limitations of traditional voting systems.
DAVINCI gives DAOs flexible, verifiable, and anonymous voting with the same guarantees as onchain voting.Perfect for treasury decisions, governance proposals, or high-frequency polls.
Governments can run digital elections that are secure, inclusive, and cost-effective.
DAVINCI ensures integrity and transparency for everything from local referendums to participatory budgeting.
DAVINCI helps traditional organizations access trusted, anonymous voting.Ideal for internal governance or stakeholder decisions.
DAVINCI’s schema-free ballot format means organizers can define any rules they want.Even for voting systems no one’s imagined yet.

We've collected some common questions about DAVINCI. If your question isn't covered feel free to reach out on X, Discord or Farcaster.

DAVINCI (Decentralized Autonomous Voting Infrastructure with Cryptographic Integrity) is a neutral and unstoppable voting protocol designed for privacy, scalability, and security. It enables high-frequency, low-cost elections while ensuring transparency, censorship resistance, anti-coercion, and integrity.

Built as a Layer 2 solution on Ethereum, DAVINCI ensures votes remain tamper-proof and trustless, eliminating central points of failure.

Technically, DAVINCI relies on cryptographic methods such as zkSNARKs and threshold homomorphic encryption (ElGamal), ensuring votes remain private yet verifiable, preventing abuses such as vote-buying. The protocol also handles data availability via Ethereum data blobs (EIP-4844), making high-volume elections feasible without overwhelming the main blockchain.

In summary, DAVINCI is the first solution that meets all the criteria for a universal voting protocol accessible to the masses.
